one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent wrote path.tsv with an invalid step-0 row containing an empty tile field (instead of move-only rows), and the BFS terminated upon first goal discovery without completing the full frontier at goal depth, leaving L30.txt with an incomplete set of states.
t_err_evidence: agent creates bfs_solver.py with step-0 empty-tile row and incomplete BFS frontier at goal depth
t_commit_evidence: In step 7, the agent creates bfs_solver_fixed.py which retains the identical write_path_tsv function with the empty-tile step-0 row and still returns on first goal discovery ('if neighbor == goal_state: ... layers[depth] = next_layer; return path, layers') before completing the full goal-depth frontier. The corrected script is run at step 8 producing all output files, locking in the defective artifacts.
t_surface_evidence: head -10 path.tsv reveals step 0 row with empty tile field: '0\t\t010203040506070008'
trigger_explanation: The agent never carefully read or internalized the output format specification for path.tsv (that rows must be move-only with valid tile numbers, no initial-state row) nor the requirement that BFS must complete the full frontier at each depth before moving to the next. It proceeded to implement without verifying these contract details.
